theorems.name: Submission.allard_tc_stationary_cone_flat
theorems.statement: StationaryMonotonicityIdentity → ConstancyTheorem → ∀ (N n : ℕ) (C : Varifold N n (univ : Set (Euclidean N))) (θ₀ : ℝ), 0 < θ₀ → C.Stationary → (∀ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ → C.weight (closedBall 0 ρ) = ENNReal.ofReal θ₀ * unitBallVolume n * ENNReal.ofReal ρ ^ n) → (∀ᵐ y ∂C.weight, ∃ θ : ℝ≥0∞, HasDensity n C.weight y θ ∧ ENNReal.ofReal θ₀ ≤ θ) → ∃ T : Grassmannian N n, C.measure = ENNReal.ofReal θ₀ • planeVarifoldMeasure T
